body: The second key was a small, unassuming square, but it seemed to loom larger in my mind than the first, which was bulky and made of metal. I couldn't shake off the feeling that it was watching me, waiting for me. I felt my heart rate quicken as I rummaged through my desk drawers, searching for a place to stash it, any place to get away from its presence. As I glanced around the room, I noticed the familiar faces of the people I'd grown accustomed to spending my days with. They seemed normal, friendly even, but I knew better.
